name: Emby
description: Refreshes the Emby libraries when a package finishes.

codes.emby_notifier.setting.path_mapping.descr: One line per folder: rDownloader's path=the path Emby sees, e.g. /downloads=/data/media. The longest matching path decides and Emby scans the folder that holds the package instead of every library; without a matching line every library is refreshed.
